claims.text: The hotel sits on the water in Lower Manhattan, steps from Wall Street and the Financial District.

findings.quote: Located on the water in Lower Manhattan in the iconic Battery Maritime Building, steps from Wall Street and the Financial District

claims.text: The building is the former Governors Island ferry terminal.

findings.quote: waterfront location in the former Governors Island ferry terminal

claims.text: The guestrooms and suites were designed by Thierry Despont, and many have private terraces overlooking the East River, the Brooklyn Bridge and the Statue of Liberty.

findings.quote: Designed by Thierry Despont, our forty-seven uniquely decorated Guestrooms and Suites, many with private terraces, overlooking the East River, the Brooklyn Bridge and the Statue of Liberty.

claims.text: The corridors have lacquered hand rails and portholes on the guestroom doors.

findings.quote: When you walk down the hallway en route to your room or suite
down to the lacquered hand rail and portholes on the guestroom doors

claims.text: The vaulted porch ceiling on the street-facing side of the building still has the original Guastavino tiles.

findings.quote: the vaulted porch ceiling on the street-facing side of the building still has the original Guastavino tiles

claims.text: Two Presidential Suites are customized with Loro Piana Interiors.

findings.quote: Two Presidential Suites are customized with Loro Piana Interiors.

claims.text: Before check-in, guests can choose between Italian cotton or Italian linen sheets.

findings.quote: The sheets on the bed are from the 150-year-old luxury linen house Rivolta Carmignani
Prior to check in guests can choose between Italian cotton or Italian linen.

claims.text: Casa Cipriani Wellness features cast iron architectural details and state-of-the-art equipment.

findings.quote: Casa Cipriani Wellness features unique cast iron architectural details, and is furnished with state-of-the-art equipment.

claims.text: After a workout, guests can relax in eucalyptus steam baths, cryotherapy and traditional cedar saunas.

findings.quote: post workout guest can relax in our eucalyptus steam baths, cryotherapy and traditional cedar saunas

claims.text: Casa Cipriani is a private members club in lower Manhattan.

findings.quote: A true private members club in the modern sense, Casa Cipriani, located in lower Manhattan

claims.text: The formal restaurant's interior is inspired by the dining room of a French ocean liner of the thirties.

findings.quote: formal restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner every day. The elegant interior is inspired by the glamorous dining room of a French ocean liner of the thirties.

claims.text: Guests visiting Casa Cipriani New York may enjoy a complimentary ride in the House Car.

findings.quote: While you are visiting Casa Cipriani New York, you may enjoy a complimentary ride in our House Car.

claims.text: Casa Cipriani is in the historic 1909 Battery Maritime Building, overlooking the Statue of Liberty and New York Harbor.

findings.quote: Casa Cipriani resides in the historic 1909 Battery Maritime Building overlooking the majestic Statue of Liberty and New York Harbor

claims.text: Thierry Despont wanted guests to feel like they were on a vintage luxury ocean liner.

findings.quote: Despont wanted guests to feel like they were on a vintage luxury ocean liner.

claims.text: The Roebling Presidential Suite has a wraparound terrace facing the Brooklyn Bridge, Brooklyn and the East River.

findings.quote: ROEBLING PRESIDENTIAL SUITE (ONE BEDROOM)
it boasts an 841-square-foot wraparound terrace facing the Brooklyn Bridge, Brooklyn, and the East River

claims.text: The spa's hand-picked therapists offer signature massages and treatments including acupuncture, pain management, skincare and medical stress recovery.

findings.quote: offers a range of signature massages and wellness experiences from a team of hand-picked therapists, including acupuncture, pain management, skincare and medical stress recovery

claims.text: The Jazz Cafe offers dinner with live music, with a pianist and two different jazz bands alternating each evening.

findings.quote: It offers dinner with live music performances; a pianist and two different jazz bands alternate each evening

claims.text: A dress code applies: members and guests are asked to respect the Beaux-Arts tradition of the landmark building through appropriate attire.

findings.quote: Our landmark building evokes the refined elegance of the Beaux-Arts period, and we ask that all members and guests respect the tradition of that era through appropriate attire.

claims.text: After 5:00 PM children are not permitted in any areas of the 5th Floor or Rooftop.

findings.quote: After 5:00 PM children are not permitted in any areas of the 5th Floor or Rooftop.

claims.text: The Wellness Center is exclusively for the Casa Cipriani community, while the Spa can be reserved by non-member guests.

findings.quote: While the Wellness Center is exclusively available to the Casa Cipriani community, the Spa can be reserved by non-member guests.
